race.comment: IN A TIZZY (10) resumes. She showed ability in four runs last campaign in Sydney. She's a well bred Zoustar mare who can be an improver with a spell under the belt, look for her to kick up from the inside and take catching. BIG KAPOW (1) ran a good race first up Moe when showing pace, only run down late. He should come on nicely from that and can go one better crossing over from out wide. SHE'S LOADED (12) is racing well with three placings in a row. She chased home a good one at Kilmore last time and that form should hold up well. Debutant MOZ (3) also holds some intrigue off some sound jumpouts. Watch for a market push.
